messages:
elaine: FYI - got a support ticket where a customer downloaded a CSV from the Console insights page and it contained rows from another org. Not great :grimacing:
raj: oh no. any repro steps in the ticket?
elaine: they said: Insights -> Reports -> Export CSV (last 30 days). We pulled the CSV and there were ~12 rows with a different org_id in the id column.
sam: does the export go through the metrics service or the query service?
elaine: export hits /internal/insights/export -> fetches precomputed rows from metrics-cache then enriches. looks like enrichment was fine, but cache returned extra rows.
maria: most likely cache key scope? i remember a change last month where we added a sharded prefix to cache keys for performance.
raj: can you grep logs for the cache key used? elaine, any request-id in the ticket?
elaine: ticket includes request id: req_0a9f2c. logs: `insights-export req_0a9f2c cache_key=metric:v2:shard-7:global-summary`
sam: there's the problem - cache_key has "global-summary" but should include `org:<<org_id>>`. That key would be shared across orgs if fallback happened.
maria: how did shard-7 become global-summary? previous patch had a fallback path that strips org id when metrics service times out.
raj: timeline: when did that patch land?
maria: merged 2025-11-03 by me. It added a cheaper key for legacy queries: `metric:v2:shard-{shard}:global-summary` to avoid hot misses. We assumed enrichment would re-filter.
elaine: enrichment step uses the rows from cache and does a join on project_id; looks like the join failed to filter out rows for other orgs in this path.
sam: two problems then: (1) cache key is not org-scoped; (2) downstream enrichment isn't validating org ownership. Fix both.
raj: agreed. Quick mitigation: stop serving the `global-summary` key for exports until we have a proper scoping guarantee. We can invalidate the problematic keyspace.
maria: I can revert the fallback in metrics service or flip a config to disable the global key immediately.
elaine: can we also add a runtime guard in the console that asserts `row.org_id == request.org_id` and drops rows otherwise? cheap second line of defense.
sam: yes, add defensive filter in export path and add an invariant test in CI.
ops-bot: Incident triage created: INC-2025-47 - Console export cross-org rows. Priority: P2. Assigned to: eng-platform.
raj: rollout plan: 1) flip config to disable global-summary key (maria) 2) server-side defensive filter in console (sam) 3) add cache-key change to include org_id (maria) 4) add integration test and canary deploy (elaine) 5) invalidate known global keys.
maria: I'll open a revert PR for the fallback now and tag it `hotfix/metrics-global-key`.
sam: I'll draft the console patch with the extra filter and unit test. keep it small: short-circuit to drop any row with mismatched org id and log count. Example log: `export-filter dropped=3 request.org=org_83`
elaine: also need telemetry fix: quota attribution was incremented against wrong org for exported rows. We should re-run attribution for the period and notify billing if needed.
raj: yeah, telemetry pipeline tags are often derived from the enrichment step; if enrichment missed scoping, tags wrong. ops-team flag for billing follow-up.
maria: deploying revert to staging first. will create canary deploy to 10% for 30m then full.
sam: CI checklist: unit test, integration (local with multi-org fixtures), smoke export to ensure CSV shape unchanged.
elaine: PM/customer comms: I'll prepare a short note to SRE/support with recommended customer-facing wording. we should say "We found an intermittent scoping bug in CSV exports that may include rows from other orgs. We have disabled the fallback and are rolling out a fix."
raj: good. Also add rollback plan: re-enable fallback config if revert fails (we have that toggle).
deploy-bot: deploy started for hotfix/metrics-global-key -> staging (sha: a1b2c3d) by maria
maria: staging looks clean. running export smoke.
elaine: export smoke passed for org_83, org_92. no cross rows.
sam: will push console filter PR now.
raj: after both are live, we should run a backfill job to detect any historical exports that used the global key and produce a list of affected request_ids. then contact legal/billing if needed.
elaine: noted. I'll own the backfill and customer outreach. adding to INC-2025-47.
ops-bot: INC-2025-47 updated: mitigation in progress, ETA full fix 3h.
maria: metrics fix promoted to prod (canary 20% -> full) sha a1b2c3d.
sam: console filter merged and rolled out canary. logs show `export-filter dropped=2 request.org=org_83` on a few requests - looks like we caught some leakage.
elaine: thanks team. follow-up items: - telemetry re-attribution - backfill affected exports - postmortem with timeline + root cause (cache fallback + missing validation)
raj: assign postmortem to eng-platform + ops, please include proposed permanent solution: include org_id in cache keys, add strict validation at enrichment, and add a test harness for multi-org export.
maria: will create the postmortem doc and link to INC.
elaine: closing loop with support: sending notice to affected customer list once we have backfill results.
sam: good job catching this fast. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks everyone. I'll update INC once backfill finishes.
